summary: Backend end-to-end pytest suite for Sapiens: 16/16 tests passed in ~40s including Claude Sonnet 4.5 diagnostic and Gemini Vision OCR endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py /auth/emergent/session: reads data['email'] directly — will raise KeyError (500) if Emergent returns unexpected payload. Consider .get() + explicit 401.
exam_routes.py /admin/import-exam: no admin-role guard — any authenticated user can insert exams. Add role check or feature-flag.
auth.py: signup does not validate password strength/length (accepts even 1-char password).
server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.

exam_routes.py submit_analysis: for-loop iterates full questions list per submission but has no timeout guard on diagnose() — a hanging Claude call could pile up requests. Consider explicit timeout/circuit breaker.
test_credentials: qa@sapiens.app / qa12345 (verified working, both login and signup paths)
seed_data_creation: Suite creates one TEST_IMPORTED_EXAM (year 2021) via /admin/import-exam and one TEST_<uuid>@sapiens.app user per run; also creates analyses under qa@sapiens.app. No cleanup — recommend main agent add teardown if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite runs with `pytest backend/tests/test_sapiens_backend.py -n 0 -v` (pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope; use -n 0 for serial). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Analysis test relies on Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and takes ~15-25s. Vision test uses a PIL-generated realistic JPEG with grid+letters — Gemini returned 200 with normalized 12-answer list. Repeated runs will create additional analyses/users; consider periodic Mongo cleanup.
